name: Bourbon Corporation
summary: Bourbon Corporation manufactures and sells confectionery, beverages, food, frozen desserts, and other products in Japan. The company offers cookies, wheat flour crackers, bean snacks, candies, deserts, rice biscuits, snacks, delicacies, chocolates, chewing gums, mineral water, coffee, cocoa beverages, and other soft drinks; and powdered cocoa, liquor, rice, bread, and instant ramen, as well as gifts. It markets its products through vending machines and mail orders. The company was formerly known as Kitanihon Shokuhin Kogyo Corporation and changed its name to Bourbon Corporation in June 1989. Bourbon Corporation was incorporated in 1924 and is based in Kashiwazaki, Japan.
